message: ゲームセンターヘレナ

name: Helena
message: 「Good morning, everyone in the Student Council!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you say 'everyone,' I'm the only one here, you know」

name: Helena
message: 「How lonely. Then let's play together」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... I don't mind, I guess. What are we going to play?」

name: Helena
message: 「When it comes to games between a man and a woman... well, ufufu\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Are you really going to make me say it out loud?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you planning to do?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Whatever you want to do, Synn-chan... you're free to do it\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's, what you'd call... s-s-s-sexy play?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heyy!」

name: Helena
message: 「Teehee!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're always teasing Synn-kun like that」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, Synn-chan was just spacing out doing nothing」

name: Ria
message: 「He was secretly doing special training!」

name: Ria
message: 「'Mental focus, peeky-peeky kaboom!'」
There's no way I could tell them I was actually grinning while thinking about today's dinner menu.

name: Helena
message: 「Right, special training!! I came here to teach you a wonderful training method」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Helena
message: 「I heard from Ria. Apparently, there's something wonderful at Synn-chan's house」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, what did you tell her?」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Ah, could it be... that thing, maybe?」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's go try it out right now」

name: Synn
message: 「Right now?」

name: Ria
message: 「Test it out...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Found it, this is the one!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, a game console. They aren't really that rare, are they?」

name: Ria
message: 「My family is actually pretty strict, you know. So we don't have any games at home at all.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right! Because of our strict upbringing, we grew up so robust!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Not that kind of \{upbringing|\s12\s12}!」
Well, in a household of just girls, I guess they wouldn't play video games very often.

name: Synn
message: 「So, what do video games have to do with special training?」

name: Helena
message: 「Simply put, image training!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I see.」

name: Helena
message: 「Or 'img-train' for short!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's such a convenient excuse. You really just want to play games and have fun.」

name: Helena
message: 「How can someone who never plays games say they have nothing to do with training?」

name: Helena
message: 「Even if it's play, improving your concentration kills two birds with one stone. Plus, it's great for training dynamic visual acuity.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see... So that's what it was...」
And just like that, Ria-senpai gets tricked.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, playing too many games will ruin your eyesight.」

name: Helena
message: 「Anyway! All we can do is use games to train! Shut up and follow me!」
What on earth is she preaching so passionately about?
Whoa!

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry, Synn-kun, for dragging you into this...」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's fine...」
S-Senpai, you're too close... Your chest is gonna touch me...

name: Ria
message: 「Once my sister gets like this, she won't listen, so could you let her play some game?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't really mind.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, thanks\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「So, Helena-san. What kind of game do you want to play?」

name: Helena
message: 「Whatever you recommend, Synn-chan!!」
Hmm...

name: Helena
message: 「What is this?! This is way too unfair!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, old games are all pretty much like that.」

name: Helena
message: 「Suddenly falling into pitfalls, knives flying out of nowhere...」

name: Helena
message: 「Plus, this assistant following behind me! All he does is chatter nonstop--he's completely useless!」

name: Synn
message: 「I figured you liked hard-boiled stories, Helena-san, so I picked a suspense game.」

name: Helena
message: 「I came here today to play a game. Let me play something that actually feels like a real game.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ending with 'Turns out they were innocent after all!!' isn't satisfying at all!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... that's because you didn't catch the real culprit--」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, hey, Synn-kun. At this rate, just a little more to go.」

name: Ria
message: 「If we just have her play a really hard game next, she's bound to give up.」
Not unfair, just difficult, huh...

name: Helena
message: 「All right!! Made it to Asakusa!! We did it, Momoko!!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... Even I've never managed to clear that...」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis. You've played this game before, haven't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm? It's my first time. I struggled a bit at first, but once you get the hang of it, it's really no big deal.」

name: Ria
message: 「Uuu... What do we do, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「At this rate, she's going to beat every single game we have...!」

name: Helena
message: 「Phew, I'm completely satisfied. Well, I'm heading home now. Thanks, Synn-chan.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「I can't let myself lose to the young ones just yet~~\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... All's well that ends well, maybe\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, as long as you had fun, that's all that matters.」
Now that the storm had passed, just as I was about to clean up--

name: Ria
message: 「Ah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」
Ria-senpai is fidgeting restlessly as she watches my movements.

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai.」

name: Synn
message: 「Would you like to play a game together?」

name: Ria
message: 「...Yeah!」
So Ria-senpai actually wanted to play too.
For now, I avoid competitive modes so we don't end up fighting, and pick a co-op game instead.

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey. How am I supposed to hold this?」

name: Synn
message: 「You hold the controller like this.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh~~, I see~~」
Having our usual roles reversed like this feels kind of refreshing.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, I'll go on ahead, so just follow my lead.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, got it.」
Ria-senpai's expression is dead serious. She's even sitting on her knees--how cute.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, follow up on my punch right there!」

name: Ria
message: 「Kick! Kick! Kick!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nice!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yay! We beat it!」
The instant we defeated the stage boss dragon, Ria-senpai dropped her controller and threw her arms around me!
The body that had been leaning into me over and over until just a moment ago suddenly presses right up against me.
Ria-senpai's soft body. Among its charms, a particularly pleasant pair of mounds was sandwiching my arm.

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「We did it, Synn-kun! Does this mean we beat the game!?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No... Actually, we have to fight consecutive battles right after this...」

name: Ria
message: 「Eeeh--. Really--!?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Also... If you press up against me that closely, I can't control it properly...\s03」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, ah! S-Sorry!」
The warm sensation pulls away.
I feel a little disappointed, though I'm glad she moved before noticing how fast my heart was racing.

name: Ria
message: 「It's so fun that I just get carried away\s07」
Seeing Ria-senpai enjoy herself makes me happy too.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, let's do our best to clear it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah!」
ly reaching the end of the stage. We defeat the boss and make our way to the character who will join our party.

name: Ria
message: 「So it's a game where you rescue all sorts of allies like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, even though we rescued him, he's a thief. This character.」

name: Synn
message: 「He's a notorious thief named Ishikawa Goemon.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, I know him. He's often mentioned alongside Nezumi Kozou-san, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know if it's true or not, but they say he was a chivalrous thief.」

name: Ria
message: 「A chivalrous thief, huh...」

name: Ria
message: 「You know, I think even among people everyone treats as villains, there are wonderful ones.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like a Demon Lord, for example」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No! Just an example, just an example! They're often the final boss in games and stuff, after all\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, could you be talking about that...」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean that...?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No! Hey, what do we do next?」

name: Synn
message: 「I think we go to Dracula's castle next~」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... Dracula...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Could that be... scary?」

name: Synn
message: 「It might be scary, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, I'm playing! Scary stuff doesn't bother me at all!」
Despite saying that, once the next stage started, Ria-senpai kept looking away from the screen every now and then.
Like this, I enjoyed playing games together with Ria-senpai for a while.
